     assert response.text == "TEST"
 
 
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("explicit_cause", [False, True])
+def test_application_exception_context_is_preserved(
+    test_client_factory: TestClientFactory, explicit_cause: bool
+) -> None:
+    application_context = LookupError("application context")
+
+    async def error_endpoint(_: Request) -> None:
+        try:
+            raise application_context
+        except LookupError:
+            if explicit_cause:
+                raise RuntimeError("application error") from application_context
+            raise RuntimeError("application error")
+
+    async def passthrough(request: Request, call_next: RequestResponseEndpoint) -> Response:
+        return await call_next(request)
+
+    app = Starlette(
+        middleware=[Middleware(BaseHTTPMiddleware, dispatch=passthrough)],
+        routes=[Route("/", error_endpoint)],
+    )
+
+    client = test_client_factory(app)
+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError) as exc_info:
+        client.get("/")
+
+    assert exc_info.value.__context__ is application_context
+    assert exc_info.value.__cause__ is (application_context if explicit_cause else None)
+
+
